notes:
This is a handwritten mathematical sheet, with manuscript page 4 and the additional page numeral 117 retained. No date is present. The top Soit is struck and the following i remains live; H omits this manuscript heading; its editorial note Suite is not source ink. Both witnesses place the opening où correctly; the additional drawn leader is separately preserved as graphic ink. The cancelled heading L’introduction des Lambda_r^i remains cancelled. The opening insertion où and its curved attachment before 1 are reproduced. No reading of another page was undertaken for this return.

The source’s new display number (14), subsequent (15), reference to relations (14), and the two versions numbered (16) are retained without correcting the numbering. The short left curly stroke in (14) is drawn at its visible size and depth; it is not made into an enclosing pair. The superscript comma i,j in that display and the detached prime before infinity in the second row of (15) are retained. The marginal product Lambda_r^0 Lambda_{tau_1r}^0 ends with an unfinished equals sign; nothing has been supplied after it. The cancelled condition in (15) remains tentative in place.

The ending of redondance(s) remains uncertain because the terminal return can be an s. The added pour i=0 et i=infinity is raised above the cancelled les relations du type Lambda_r^0=1. There is no supported initial et or toutes and no live et after the cancelled text. The curved revision hook is reproduced.

The first (16) and its following prose form a cancelled block: the formula frame and six long diagonal cancelling strokes are drawn together. In that formula three inverse clusters really remain visible, including the one on the first a and the one after lambda’s raised 1; the lambda cluster has not been enclosed in invented parentheses. The subscript of the first beta has a looped sigma_1r although nearby factor indices use tau_1r. The final operator of the cancelled NB is also sigma_1r. These are literal readings, not changes made to produce a mathematically uniform identity. The earlier inverse and the raised replacement où r est remplacé have their own deletion/insertion states inside the subsequently cancelled block. The tail par sigma_1r is set once where it crosses the new frame, not duplicated in the old prose.

The left note reads: pavage par des carrés ? (dont les sommets qui ne sont pas de type 1, sont ``arrondis'', de façon à faire des hexagones évitant les trous. The opening parenthesis remains unclosed. The author’s question mark after carrés is retained. The words les and qui ne sont pas are supported by their individual letters, not restored from the corner-truncation interpretation. H’s seulement seuls is unsupported. The lower-left drawing label is lambda^0 first, Lambda^0 second: its long curved descending stroke and return favor the lowercase, but the comparison is not conclusive.

The large figure is reproduced with all written labels, the separate open corner ends, a long-dashed upper-left cross-edge, the other dotted runs, individual hatch strokes, curved paths, filled points and arrowheads. A small loop immediately before/below tau_1(r) is retained as a free ink shape; there is insufficient evidence to classify it as a deleted earlier symbol. In the evidence rows only, A through O name C’s vertices for locating comparisons; these letters are not inserted into the source drawing. The D--C and A--B shafts each have a visible left head and a filled right endpoint. No independent right-facing tip can be isolated inside those ink masses; their filled form deliberately preserves that ambiguity. The short horizontal beside H--B has the same observational limitation. The exact separation of the heads on the thick lower return near central infinity remains less secure. The two heads on the short left vertical arc and the two additional small-triangle heads have positive visible pointed tips.

In live (16), the first a exponent is a single oval 0. Both opening parentheses of the second group remain: the group parenthesis and the inner parenthesis around a_r^infinity. The first underbrace ends under the closing group parenthesis, before the uncertain raised +/minus-one cluster; the cluster is placed outside that underbrace. The small cancelled minus-one beside the first beta is preserved tentatively. The frame’s left gaps and upper notch, including its intersection with the old NB tail, are drawn. The right margin has poser, not prendre, and no final period. Its X has a flourished upper stroke but no secure separate hat.

The author writes relation stable par passage de r à tau_1(r), donc il suffit de la poser pour r in calligraphic R^+ (si X orientable). That assertion has not been independently established here. The actual checks made in this run are recorded separately: enumerating the retained ordered index pairs, reversing the two base words as formal free words, and counting the sides after truncating two corners of the local quadrilateral. None chooses the uncertain outer exponent or proves the presentation/elimination argument globally.

Crop provenance: all eleven saved crops were made once from the original-coordinate boxes in crop_boxes, enlarged with LANCZOS to approximately 3200 pixels on the longer side after mild autocontrast and sharpening. The tiling_note crop alone was rotated by -12 degrees; the other ten have rotation 0. Each saved crop was personally viewed once. Original and both existing native overlapping halves were personally viewed once before these crops. Main reader independently inspected the original and all eleven saved crops and communicated the listed local adjudications, including revisits for the two thick shafts and first-underbrace scope. These main views are not counted as this reader’s own views. No OCR, external research or LaTeX compilation was performed.

Comparison limit for H drawings: the drawing files referred to by H are unavailable in this packet. H’s prose description is not treated as a complete geometric assertion. Accordingly the individual geometric differences here are C-only whenever H makes no specific local assertion. The only retained local H-label omission is the lower-left lambda-zero label absent from the supplied large-figure description. There is no whole-figure omission row for either drawing. The old-frame row concerns visible frame geometry, not the mere use of a strike macro instead of drawn oblique cancellation.
